about.heading: Led by Levan Kurdadze
about.body: Levan Kurdadze is an international trade and export-import consultant with over ten years driving market entry for Georgian producers. As Export Manager and Partner Relations Development Manager at Tbilvino, one of Georgia's leading wineries, he attracted 24 new partner companies across 16 countries and generated over 7 million GEL in export revenue (33% net profit), opening markets including Ukraine, the Baltics, Turkey, China, France, Poland, the UAE, the USA, and Japan. In 2025, the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) appointed him National Trade and Marketing Consultant to lead a value-chain analysis and export-diversification strategy for Georgia's wine sector. He has represented producers at 15+ international trade fairs, including Vinexpo Paris, Prowein Shanghai, CIIE Shanghai, FOODEX Tokyo, and IWSE Seoul. He holds dual master's degrees in International Business Management (Georgia and Spain) and is a Certified Export Manager (Enterprise Georgia), fluent in English and Russian.

hero.headline: Market entry, run by someone who has done it before.
hero.lead: Millennium Consulting Georgia (MCG) is an international trade and marketing consultancy led by Levan Kurdadze. We help producers enter and grow in export markets, and help international partners source quality Georgian products with confidence, handling the complexity of cross-border trade so you can focus on what you make.

principal.name: Levan Kurdadze
principal.heading: Led by Levan Kurdadze
principal.p1: Levan is an international trade and export-import consultant with over ten years driving market entry for Georgian producers. As Export Manager and Partner Relations Development Manager at Tbilvino, one of Georgia's leading wineries, he opened markets across Europe, Asia and North America, attracting 24 new partner companies across 16 countries and generating over 7 million GEL in export revenue at 33% net profit. He worked on the ground as export manager in China, South Korea, Japan, Turkey, Hungary and the UAE.
principal.p2: His work goes beyond placing existing products. At Tbilvino he led product development, including building a Bag-in-Box line from scratch, and he has represented producers at 15+ international trade fairs, among them Vinexpo Paris, Prowein Shanghai, CIIE Shanghai, FOODEX Tokyo and IWSE Seoul.
principal.p3: In 2025, the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) appointed him National Trade and Marketing Consultant to lead a value-chain analysis and export-diversification strategy for Georgia's wine sector, institutional recognition of his expertise. He has also handled inbound representation, acting as the Georgia representative for a California-based manufacturer and running the process from market research and partner identification through to signed distribution.

hero.lead: MCG moves products, and the brands behind them, between markets. Two directions out (taking producers into new markets, sourcing for buyers who want them) and two directions in (positioning a product for a market it wasn't built for, and representing foreign brands here). Every engagement is led personally by Levan Kurdadze.

services.title: Export & market entry
services.summary: Taking a product into a market that doesn't know it yet, from strategy to a signed distributor.

detail.intro: Not remote brokering. On-the-ground export management in China, South Korea, Japan, Turkey, Hungary, and the UAE, with markets opened across three continents.

proof.text: Built and ran the export function at Tbilvino: 24 new partner companies across 16 countries, 7M+ GEL export revenue at 33% net profit.

services.title: Wine & spirits sourcing
services.summary: Direct, vetted access to producers worth representing, for buyers and importers.

detail.intro: Buyer-side access built from a decade on both sides of the table. Introductions are vetted before they reach you, with samples and terms handled on the ground.

proof.text: 15+ international trade fairs worked, backed by on-the-ground export experience across China, South Korea, Japan, Turkey, and the UAE.

services.title: Marketing & brand development
services.summary: Repositioning a product for a market it wasn't built for.

detail.intro: A product built for one market rarely lands in another unchanged. The work spans repositioning, packaging, and the line extensions that make a brand make sense to a first-time buyer.

proof.text: National Trade & Marketing Consultant for the FAO (2025), leading value-chain analysis and export-diversification strategy for Georgia's wine sector.

services.title: Import & representation
services.summary: Local representation for foreign brands entering Georgia and the region.

detail.intro: The same method works in reverse. Foreign brands entering Georgia and the wider region get local representation that runs the full cycle, and it isn't wine-only.

proof.text: Georgia representative for a US (California) manufacturer, carrying the engagement end to end, from market research to a closed distribution agreement.
